name: Mirror Door
description: The reflection of a wall shows a phantom door where none exists. This door can only be manipulated while viewed through the mirror's reflection.
disable: DC 18 Thievery check to open the door while viewing the reflection

offensiveAbilities.name: Appear
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature views the wall through a mirror's reflection

Effect A door appears in the mirror's reflection of the wall. The triggering creature can open and manipulate this door only as long as they view it through the mirror and only by succeeding at a DC 18 Thievery check to disable the trap.
